fact: The monitoring volume of the 2022-2030 national health development plan states the SNIS migrated from Maurisis to DHIS2, and sets SNIS reporting completeness at 95% in 2021 with a target of 100% by 2025 and promptness at 50% rising to 80%.
title: Plan National de Développement Sanitaire 2022-2030, Volume II: Plan Intégré de Suivi Evaluation (PISE)
publisher: Ministère de la Santé, République Islamique de Mauritanie
why_not: The document carries no date of its own.
